title: Mother's & Father's Day Worksheets | Kindergarten Practice Pack
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.K.2d, RF.K.3, RL.K.1

Give your learners extra practice with Mother's & Father's Day! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Mother's & Father's Day Words
  • Ways to Say Thank You
  • A Special Card
  • Build Family Love Words
  • Family Fun Memory
  • Ways I Can Help
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Mother's & Father's Day Words, Ways to Say Thank You, A Special Card, Build Family Love Words, Family Fun Memory, Ways I Can Help), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Holidays, Art & Coding Bundle and the Mega Bundle.

Terms: one license for one home or one teacher. Please do not share or post publicly. Thank you!
